name: GUIDEcx
description: Customer onboarding and project management platform. Track onboarding projects, milestones and tasks, update task progress and post updates to project or task message channels.

api_token.label: API Token
api_token.help_text: GUIDEcx Open API bearer token. Generate it in the GUIDEcx web app under Company Settings -> Open API. A workspace admin role is required to create tokens.

list_projects.description: Search onboarding projects, optionally filtered by status, status category, customer, project manager or tag.

status.description: Filter by workspace-specific status labels (for example 'Kickoff'). Use status_category for portable filtering.

status_category.description: Filter by standard project status categories.

project_manager_id.description: Filter by project manager member IDs.

updated_after.description: Only return projects updated at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp (for example 2026-01-31T00:00:00Z).

updated_before.description: Only return projects updated at or before this ISO 8601 timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return.

offset.description: Number of projects to skip, for pagination.

total.description: Total number of projects matching the filters.

limit.description: Page size used for this request.

offset.description: Offset used for this request.

has_more.description: True when more projects remain beyond this page.

get_project.description: Retrieve a single onboarding project by its ID.

project_id.description: The ID of the project to retrieve.

list_milestones.description: List the milestones belonging to a project, in their display order.

project_id.description: The ID of the project whose milestones to list.

phase_id.description: Optionally restrict results to a single phase.

limit.description: Maximum number of milestones to return.

offset.description: Number of milestones to skip, for pagination.

total.description: Total number of milestones matching the filters.

limit.description: Page size used for this request.

offset.description: Offset used for this request.

has_more.description: True when more milestones remain beyond this page.

list_tasks.description: Search tasks, optionally filtered by project, milestone, assignee, status category or name.

project_id.description: Only return tasks in this project.

milestone_id.description: Only return tasks in this milestone.

assignee_id.description: Only return tasks assigned to this member.

status_category.description: Filter by standard task status categories.

name.description: Match tasks by exact or partial name.

type_filter.description: Which task types to include. Defaults to ALL.

updated_after.description: Only return tasks updated at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return.

offset.description: Number of tasks to skip, for pagination.

total.description: Total number of tasks matching the filters.

limit.description: Page size used for this request.

offset.description: Offset used for this request.

has_more.description: True when more tasks remain beyond this page.

update_task.description: Update an existing task's status, due date, assignee or priority.

project_id.description: The ID of the project the task belongs to.

task_id.description: The ID of the task to update.

status.description: The new status label for the task, as configured in the workspace (for example 'In Progress').

end_date.description: New due date, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

assignee_id.description: Member ID to assign the task to.

task.description: The updated task as returned by GUIDEcx.

add_task_note.description: Post a note to a task's message channel. The note is attributed to the owner of the API token.

task_id.description: The ID of the task to post the note to.

content.description: The note body. Supports basic HTML formatting.

internal_only.description: When true the note is visible only to internal team members, not the customer. Defaults to false.

messages.description: The created messages as returned by GUIDEcx.

get_customer.description: Retrieve a customer record by its ID.

customer_id.description: The ID of the customer to retrieve.

list_phases.description: List the phases of a project, in display order. Phases are the top level of the project structure: a phase contains milestones, which contain tasks.

project_id.description: The ID of the project whose phases to list.

limit.description: Maximum number of phases to return.

offset.description: Number of phases to skip, for pagination.

total.description: Total number of phases matching the filters.

limit.description: Page size used for this request.

offset.description: Offset used for this request.

has_more.description: True when more phases remain beyond this page.

list_project_members.description: List the members assigned to a project, including their role on that project. Use this to find who manages an onboarding.

project_id.description: The ID of the project whose team to list.

limit.description: Maximum number of members to return.

offset.description: Number of members to skip, for pagination.

projectRole.description: Role on this project (PROJECT_MANAGER, TEAM_MEMBER or CUSTOM).

view.description: Default project view for this member.

total.description: Total number of project members matching the filters.

limit.description: Page size used for this request.

offset.description: Offset used for this request.

has_more.description: True when more project members remain beyond this page.

remove_project_member.description: Remove a member from a project's team. This does not deactivate the member in the workspace, it only unassigns them from this project.

project_id.description: The ID of the project to remove the member from.

member_id.description: The ID of the member to remove.

removed.description: True when the member was removed.

member_id.description: The ID of the member that was removed.

list_members.description: Search the members of the workspace, optionally filtered by email, role or invitation status.

limit.description: Maximum number of members to return.

offset.description: Number of members to skip, for pagination.

total.description: Total number of members matching the filters.

limit.description: Page size used for this request.

offset.description: Offset used for this request.

has_more.description: True when more members remain beyond this page.

list_roles.description: List the roles configured in the workspace. Role IDs are needed when assigning members to projects or tasks.

limit.description: Maximum number of roles to return.

offset.description: Number of roles to skip, for pagination.

category.description: Whether the role is INTERNAL or EXTERNAL.

total.description: Total number of roles matching the filters.

limit.description: Page size used for this request.

offset.description: Offset used for this request.

has_more.description: True when more roles remain beyond this page.

list_webhooks.description: List the webhooks configured in the workspace, with their last delivery success and failure timestamps.

include_disabled.description: When true, also return webhooks that have been disabled. Defaults to false.

limit.description: Maximum number of webhooks to return.

offset.description: Number of webhooks to skip, for pagination.

event_type.description: The event that triggers the webhook. GUIDEcx returns this as null on upsert responses.

disabled_at.description: When the webhook was disabled, if it has been.

last_success_at.description: When the webhook last delivered successfully.

last_failure_at.description: When the webhook last failed to deliver.

total.description: Total number of webhooks matching the filters.

limit.description: Page size used for this request.

offset.description: Offset used for this request.

has_more.description: True when more webhooks remain beyond this page.

upsert_webhook.description: Create a webhook subscription, or update an existing one by passing its ID. Use this to receive GUIDEcx events instead of polling.

event_type.description: The event that triggers the webhook. GUIDEcx only accepts lowercase dotted names and rejects anything else.

url.description: HTTPS URL that GUIDEcx will POST the event to.

description.description: Optional description of the webhook's purpose.

webhook_id.description: Pass an existing webhook ID to update it instead of creating a new one.

event_type.description: The event that triggers the webhook. GUIDEcx returns this as null on upsert responses.

disabled_at.description: When the webhook was disabled, if it has been.

last_success_at.description: When the webhook last delivered successfully.

last_failure_at.description: When the webhook last failed to deliver.

delete_webhook.description: Delete a webhook subscription by its ID.

webhook_id.description: The ID of the webhook to delete.

deleted.description: True when the webhook was deleted.

webhook_id.description: The ID of the webhook that was deleted.

list_time_categories.description: List the time categories configured in the workspace, including whether each is billable. Category IDs are needed when logging time.

limit.description: Maximum number of time categories to return.

offset.description: Number of time categories to skip, for pagination.

billable.description: Whether time in this category is billable.

billableRate.description: Billable hourly rate for this category.

total.description: Total number of time categories matching the filters.

limit.description: Page size used for this request.

offset.description: Offset used for this request.

has_more.description: True when more time categories remain beyond this page.

list_time_records.description: Search logged time, optionally filtered by project, task, member, time category or the date the work was performed.

project_id.description: Only return time logged against this project.

task_id.description: Only return time logged against this task.

member_id.description: Filter by the members who logged the time.

worked_after.description: Only return time worked on or after this ISO 8601 date.

worked_before.description: Only return time worked on or before this ISO 8601 date.

limit.description: Maximum number of time records to return.

offset.description: Number of time records to skip, for pagination.

total.description: Total number of time records matching the filters.

limit.description: Page size used for this request.

offset.description: Offset used for this request.

has_more.description: True when more time records remain beyond this page.

log_task_time.description: Log hours worked against a task. The time is attributed to the member given in member_id.

task_id.description: The ID of the task to log time against.

member_id.description: The ID of the member who performed the work.

date_of_work.description: The date the work was performed, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

time_category_id.description: Optional time category ID. Use List Time Categories to find one.

log_project_time.description: Log hours worked against a project rather than a specific task. Use this for work that is not tied to a single task. The time is attributed to the member given in member_id.

project_id.description: The ID of the project to log time against.

member_id.description: The ID of the member who performed the work.

date_of_work.description: The date the work was performed, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

time_category_id.description: Optional time category ID. Use List Time Categories to find one.

create_project.description: Create an onboarding project. A customer can be created inline by passing customer_name, and the project manager is set by passing project_manager_id.

name.description: Name of the project to create.

template_id.description: Optional project template ID. A template scaffolds the phases, milestones and tasks; without one the project is created empty.

customer_id.description: Optional ID of an existing customer to attach.

customer_name.description: Name for a new customer to create and attach. Requires customer_domain. Ignored when customer_id is given.

customer_domain.description: Email domain for the new customer. Requires customer_name. Ignored when customer_id is given.

project_manager_id.description: Optional member ID to assign as project manager.

start_date.description: Optional project start date, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

end_date.description: Optional project end date, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

status.description: Optional initial status label. Must exist in the workspace.

tags.description: Tags to add. Tags are additive rather than a replacement set: existing tags are kept and duplicates are ignored. Pass an empty array to remove all tags.

cash_value.description: Optional contract value for the project.

customer_id.description: ID of the attached customer, if the project has one.

update_project.description: Update an existing project's name, dates, status, tags or contract value. Fields left unset are not modified.

project_id.description: The ID of the project to update.

start_date.description: New start date, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

end_date.description: New end date, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

status.description: New status label. Must exist in the workspace.

status_explanation.description: Optional explanation for the status change.

tags.description: Tags to add. Tags are additive rather than a replacement set: existing tags are kept and duplicates are ignored. Pass an empty array to remove all tags.

cash_value.description: New contract value for the project.

create_phase.description: Create a phase in a project. Phases are the top level of the project structure and hold milestones.

project_id.description: The ID of the project to add the phase to.

template_id.description: Optional phase template ID to build the phase from.

placement.description: Where to insert the new item in its parent's ordering. Defaults to at_end.

create_milestone.description: Create a milestone inside a phase. Milestones hold tasks, so one is required before tasks can be added to a project.

project_id.description: The ID of the project the milestone belongs to.

phase_id.description: The ID of the phase to add the milestone to. Use List Phases to find one.

template_id.description: Optional milestone template ID to build the milestone from.

placement.description: Where to insert the new item in its parent's ordering. Defaults to at_end.

create_task.description: Create a task under a milestone. GUIDEcx requires every task to sit inside a milestone, so milestone_id is mandatory.

project_id.description: The ID of the project the task belongs to.

milestone_id.description: The ID of the milestone to create the task under. Use List Milestones to find one.

description.description: Optional task description. Supports basic HTML formatting.

start_date.description: Optional start date, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

end_date.description: Optional due date, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

assignee_id.description: Optional member ID to assign the task to.

responsibility.description: Which party is responsible for the task. Defaults to INTERNAL.

visibility.description: How much of the task the customer can see. Defaults to VISIBLE.

estimated_hours.description: Optional estimated hours for the task.

tags.description: Tags to add. Tags are additive rather than a replacement set: existing tags are kept and duplicates are ignored. Pass an empty array to remove all tags.

placement.description: Where to insert the new item in its parent's ordering. Defaults to at_end.

list_dependencies.description: List task dependencies, filtered by project or by the items on either side of the dependency. This endpoint does not paginate.

project_id.description: Only return dependencies within this project.

parent_id.description: Filter by the IDs of items that must complete first.

dependent_id.description: Filter by the IDs of items that wait on a parent.

parentId.description: The ID of the item that must complete first.

dependentId.description: The ID of the item that waits on the parent.

add_dependency.description: Make one task depend on another, so the dependent cannot start until the parent completes.

parent_id.description: The ID of the task that must complete first.

dependent_id.description: The ID of the task that waits on the parent.

parentId.description: The ID of the item that must complete first.

dependentId.description: The ID of the item that waits on the parent.

remove_dependency.description: Remove a dependency between two tasks.

parent_id.description: The ID of the parent task in the dependency.

dependent_id.description: The ID of the dependent task in the dependency.

removed.description: True when the dependency was removed.
